description: This file defines a static class ContentReader that provides methods for reading PDF content streams from various sources such as PdfPage objects, byte arrays, and MemoryStreams. It utilizes a CParser to parse the content and returns a CSequence representing the parsed content.

classes.name: ContentReader
classes.description: A static utility class for reading and parsing PDF content streams from different input types.

methods.name: ReadContent(PdfPage page)
methods.description: Reads the content stream of the provided PdfPage object and returns a sequence of content objects.

methods.name: ReadContent(byte[] content)
methods.description: Reads PDF content from a byte array and returns a sequence of content objects.

methods.name: ReadContent(MemoryStream content)
methods.description: Reads PDF content from a MemoryStream and returns a sequence of content objects.
